description: Two sample and hold channels, each capturing a voltage when it is told to

inputs.text: A rising edge here captures the voltage at that channel's IN jack and holds it until the next edge
The voltage that channel captures when its SAM jack rises

outputs.text: The voltage captured at that channel's last trigger, held until the next one

notes: A polyphonic cable carries at most four channels; each channel's voice count follows its IN jack, and its SAM jack maps voice for voice onto it.
